probe_source: git archive HEAD extracted to a temporary directory, then instrumentation.patch applied; original product sources and executable unchanged
probe_method: Instant durations appended to a process-global mutex vector; one stderr dump after runtime.block_on returns, before telemetry shutdown. No per-event file writes. No asynchronous wait is replaced or reordered. Probe overhead and code layout effects remain in the observation.
execution_method: No ps monitor and no time wrapper. perf_counter_ns around Popen and blocking wait with a SIGALRM process-group timeout (30s). stdout/stderr to files; metrics enabled on both binaries. One worker, identical saved plan per case, empty test commands, best-effort memory, max-copy-size256MiB/max-workspace-size512MiB/min-free-space10GiB. CLI run TMPDIR isolated and removed outside timing for every invocation. Warm filesystem cache; no builds/tests concurrent; other applications not isolated.
ordering: one discarded warmup per binary/case; 7 seeded shuffled case rounds, within each pair baseline first on even rounds, probe first on odd rounds; direct controls 31 each after 3 warmups each in shuffled pairs
scope_limits: Synthetic fixtures only. Python is 3.12.6. No pytest suite, dirty-output workload, multiple workers, cold cache, Windows/Linux, CPU or allocation profile. Direct controls inherit host environment/cwd, while Hoimin rewrites worker environment/cwd. Wait is elapsed time including child execution/scheduling, not CPU time. Cleanup metrics are integer ms. Raw archive includes warmups and plans.
